Plot spatial variables for random forest models

Author

Max Lindmark

Published

2025-03-19

Load packages & source functions

library(tidyverse)
library(tidylog)
library(RCurl)
library(devtools)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(patchwork)
library(concaveman)
library(ggtext)

# Source code for map plots
devtools::source_url("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maxlindmark/spatial-metabolic-index/main/R/functions/map-plot.R")
options(ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis")

# Set path
home <- here::here()

Load data

d <- read_csv(paste0(home, "/output/rf_dat_short.csv"))

Plot environmental variables!

pal <- brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdYlBu")

# Because they are on different scales, I'll build the plot using patchwork instead of e.g. pivot longer
# First row, temperature
p1 <- plot_map_labels_fc + 
  geom_raster(data = d, aes(X*1000, Y*1000, fill = mean_temp), alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_viridis(option = "magma", name = "Mean °C") +
  theme_sleek(base_size = 8) +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.22, 0.81),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "line"),
        legend.key.width = unit(0.2, "line"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = unit(c(0,0,0,0), "cm"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 7)) +
  geom_sf(color = "gray30") +
  annotate("text", label = "Sweden", x = xmin2 + 0.3*xrange, y = ymin2 + 0.6*yrange, color = "gray50", size = 1.9) +
  annotate("text", label = "Denmark", x = xmin2 + 0.012*xrange, y = ymin2 + 0.32*yrange, color = "gray50", size = 1.9, angle = 75) +
  annotate("text", label = "Germany", x = xmin2 + 0.07*xrange, y = ymin2 + 0.02*yrange, color = "gray50", size = 1.9) +
  annotate("text", label = "Poland", x = xmin2 + 0.58*xrange, y = ymin2 + 0.02*yrange, color = "gray50", size = 1.9) +
  annotate("text", label = "Russia", x = xmin2 + 0.95*xrange, y = ymin2 + 0.18*yrange, color = "gray50", size = 1.9) +
  annotate("text", label = "Lithuania", x = xmin2 + 1*xrange, y = ymin2 + 0.43*yrange, color = "gray50", size = 1.9, angle = 75) +
  annotate("text", label = "Latvia", x = xmin2 + 0.99*xrange, y = ymin2 + 0.65*yrange, color = "gray50", size = 1.9, angle = 75) +
  annotate("text", label = "(a)", x = -Inf, y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.2, color = "gray40", size = 2.5)

p2 <- plot_map_fc + 
  geom_raster(data = d, aes(X*1000, Y*1000, fill = temp_slope), alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(name = "°C/decade", high = pal[11], low = pal[1]) + 
  theme_sleek(base_size = 8) +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.22, 0.81),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "line"),
        legend.key.width = unit(0.2, "line"),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = unit(c(0,0,0,0.25), "cm"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 6),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 7)) +
  geom_sf(color = "gray30") +
  annotate("text", label = "(b)", x = -Inf, y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.2, color = "gray40", size = 2.5)

p3 <- plot_map_fc + 
  geom_raster(data = d |> drop_na(temp_vel), aes(X*1000, Y*1000, fill = temp_vel), alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(name = "Km/decade", high = pal[11], low = pal[1]) + 
  theme_sleek(base_size = 8) +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.22, 0.81),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "line"),
        legend.key.width = unit(0.2, "line"),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = unit(c(0,0,0,0.25), "cm"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 6),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 7)) +
  geom_sf(color = "gray30") +
  facet_wrap(~"Temperature", strip.position = "right") +
  annotate("text", label = "(c)", x = -Inf, y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.2, color = "gray40", size = 2.5)

Now do biotic variables… add here the boundary!

# Read the biotic trends and velocities
trend <- d |>
  filter(cumulative == "Y") |> 
  mutate(id = paste(X, Y, group, sep = "_"))
filter: removed 35,446 rows (43%), 46,234 rows remaining
mutate: new variable 'id' (character) with 46,234 unique values and 0% NA
# Read the prediction grid and join all grid cells so that I can color the filtered cells as NA
full_grid <- crossing(d |> dplyr::select(X, Y),
                      group = unique(trend$group)) |>
  mutate(id = paste(X, Y, group, sep = "_"))
mutate: new variable 'id' (character) with 81,680 unique values and 0% NA
full_grid_trends <- full_grid |>
  filter(!id %in% unique(trend$id)) |> 
  mutate(mean_biom = NA, 
         biom_trend = NA)
filter: removed 46,234 rows (57%), 35,446 rows remaining
mutate: new variable 'mean_biom' (logical) with one unique value and 100% NA
        new variable 'biom_trend' (logical) with one unique value and 100% NA
trend <- bind_rows(trend, full_grid_trends)

# Now do old time series
trend_old <- d_old |>
  filter(cumulative == "Y") |> 
  mutate(id = paste(X, Y, group, sep = "_"))
filter: removed 25,361 rows (39%), 39,983 rows remaining
mutate: new variable 'id' (character) with 39,983 unique values and 0% NA
# Read the prediction grid and join all grid cells so that I can color the filtered cells as NA
full_grid_old <- crossing(d_old |> dplyr::select(X, Y),
                          group = unique(trend_old$group)) |>
  mutate(id = paste(X, Y, group, sep = "_"))
mutate: new variable 'id' (character) with 65,344 unique values and 0% NA
full_grid_trends_old <- full_grid_old |>
  filter(!id %in% unique(trend_old$id)) |> 
  mutate(mean_biom = NA, 
         biom_trend = NA)
filter: removed 39,983 rows (61%), 25,361 rows remaining
mutate: new variable 'mean_biom' (logical) with one unique value and 100% NA
        new variable 'biom_trend' (logical) with one unique value and 100% NA
trend_old <- bind_rows(trend_old, full_grid_trends_old)


# Because we trim the grids, let's add a polygon that is the overall outside border.
border_df <- trend
z <- concaveman(cbind(border_df$X, border_df$Y), concavity = 1)
plot(z)
z_poly <- sp::SpatialPolygons(list(sp::Polygons(list(sp::Polygon(z)), ID = 1)))
domain <- as.data.frame(z_poly@polygons[[1]]@Polygons[[1]]@coords)
colnames(domain) <- c("X", "Y")

trend2 <- bind_rows(trend, trend_old)

trend2 <- trend2 |> 
  separate_wider_delim(group, delim = "_", names = c("species", "life_stage"), cols_remove = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(life_stage = str_to_sentence(life_stage),
         species = str_to_sentence(species)) |> 
  mutate(group2 = paste(species, life_stage),
         group2 = factor(group2, 
                         levels = c("Cod Adult", "Cod Juvenile", "Flounder Adult", "Flounder Juvenile",
                                    "Plaice Adult", "Plaice Juvenile", "Turbot All", "Whiting All", "Dab All")))
mutate: changed 147,024 values (100%) of 'species' (0 new NA)
        changed 147,024 values (100%) of 'life_stage' (0 new NA)
mutate: new variable 'group2' (factor) with 9 unique values and 0% NA
plot_map_fc + 
  geom_raster(data = trend2, aes(X*1000, Y*1000, fill = biom_trend), alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(na.value="grey94", trans = "log10", midpoint = 0,
                        low = pal[1], high = pal[11]) +
  facet_wrap(~group2) +
  geom_sf(color = "gray30") +
  geom_path(data = domain, aes(X*1000, Y*1000), color = "red", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = 2) + 
  labs(fill = "Multiplicative change\nin biomass density\nper decade") +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.084, 0.915),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "line"),
        legend.key.width = unit(0.25, "line"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 6.4),
        legend.direction = "vertical",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 7))
